character: A quiet editorial publication for one author's HTML reports and the few people who read and discuss them. White paper and near-black ink, confident serif headlines, a roomy centred reading column and calm, generous spacing. Colour is kept for links, the keyboard focus ring, status and danger, so the report in its frame is what the eye lands on. The admin is the same house's back office for one expert: sans-serif, a left sidebar, list-first pages with the page's main action at the top right, hairline cards and no shadows. Danger is rare and unmistakable.

colours.name: --bg
colours.use: Page background on html, behind everything that is not a card. White paper in light, matching the report frame's own white canvas. Neutral near-black in dark.

colours.name: --surface
colours.use: The raised surface: the site header bar, admin cards (dl, inbox messages, moderation items, blocked accounts, the upload form), and text inputs and neutral buttons. In light it equals the page, and a hairline separates it. In dark it is one step up from --bg.

colours.name: --surface-2
colours.use: The sunken tint: hover fills of quiet and neutral buttons and of table rows, the current sidebar item, the draft pill, empty states, inline code and the avatar placeholder.

colours.name: --text
colours.use: Body text, headings, logins, nav and sidebar links, report titles, text on notices and tints. Light: 17.96:1 on bg and surface, 16.3:1 on surface-2. Dark: 15.58:1 on bg, 14.41:1 on surface, 12.61:1 on surface-2.

colours.name: --text-muted
colours.use: Meta lines, hints, times, bylines, table headers, dt labels, disclosure text, the draft pill, the admin lede and empty-state text. Light: 6.40:1 on bg, 5.81:1 on surface-2, 5.56:1 on accent-soft, 5.62:1 on danger-soft and ok-soft. Dark: 7.47:1 on bg, 6.91:1 on surface, 6.05:1 on surface-2, 6.22:1 on danger-soft.

colours.name: --border
colours.use: The edge of every control: neutral buttons, inputs, selects, textareas and the file-selector button. Light: 3.60:1 on bg and surface, 3.27:1 on surface-2. Dark: 4.47:1 on bg, 4.13:1 on surface, 3.62:1 on surface-2.

colours.name: --divider
colours.use: Decorative hairlines: the header's bottom edge, the votes bar, the All reports list rules, table rules, card edges, the page-head rule, the report frame edge and the avatar ring. Never the only edge of a control.

colours.name: --thread
colours.use: The 1px reply line down the left of .replies, one step stronger than --divider.

colours.name: --link
colours.use: Inline links (Link to this report, Back to the full report, continue this thread, links in hints and in the blocked lists). Visited links keep the same colour. Light: 7.17:1 on bg, 6.51:1 on surface-2, 6.23:1 on accent-soft. Dark: 8.83:1 on bg, 8.16:1 on surface, 7.15:1 on surface-2.

colours.name: --accent
colours.use: Ink. The fill of every primary button and of the Author badge, and the colour of the author-reply edge. Primary actions are ink, as in a printed page. Boundary contrast is 17.96:1 on bg in light and 15.58:1 in dark.

colours.name: --accent-hover
colours.use: The primary button fill on hover, and the link colour while pressed (:active). --on-accent on it: 12.13:1 in light, 18.42:1 in dark.

colours.name: --on-accent
colours.use: Text on an --accent or --accent-hover fill: 17.96:1 and 12.13:1 in light, 15.58:1 and 18.42:1 in dark.

colours.name: --accent-soft
colours.use: The ::selection fill. --accent on it: 15.6:1 in light, 12.78:1 in dark. --text-muted on it: 5.56:1 and 6.13:1.

colours.name: --danger
colours.use: The fill of danger buttons (Remove for everyone, Block @login, Delete this report permanently). Also the text of the Remove and Block summaries and of the blocked badge, and the edge of the confirm tray, error notices and invalid fields. Light: 6.57:1 on bg, 5.97:1 on surface-2, 5.78:1 on danger-soft. Dark: 9.48:1 on bg, 8.77:1 on surface, 7.68:1 on surface-2, 7.89:1 on danger-soft.

colours.name: --danger-hover
colours.use: The danger button fill on hover. --on-danger on it: 8.66:1 in light, above 10:1 in dark.

colours.name: --on-danger
colours.use: Text on a --danger fill: 6.57:1 in light, 8.62:1 in dark.

colours.name: --danger-soft
colours.use: The fill of the error notice, the open confirm tray and the blocked badge. --text on it: 15.78:1 in light, 12.96:1 in dark.

colours.name: --ok
colours.use: Success and live status: the left edge of 'Sent to the author.' and of .notice.ok, and the text and dot of the 'published' pill. On ok-soft: 6.16:1 in light, 8.02:1 in dark.

colours.name: --ok-soft
colours.use: The fill of success notices and of the 'published' pill. --text on it: 15.79:1 in light, 12.0:1 in dark.

colours.name: --warning
colours.use: The edge of .notice.warning. No screen uses it today. On warning-soft: 5.75:1 in light, 8.50:1 in dark.

colours.name: --warning-soft
colours.use: The fill of .notice.warning. --text on it: 15.6:1 in light, 12.0:1 in dark.

colours.name: --focus
colours.use: The keyboard focus ring on every focusable element, and the border of a focused input. It is blue, so it never blends into an ink or danger fill. At least 6.51:1 on every surface in light and 7.15:1 in dark.

colours.name: Canvas (system colour, not a token)
colours.use: The background-color of iframe only. It reproduces the browser's own canvas behind a report whose scheme matches the frame's, so the site surface never shows through the report.

type.name: --font-sans
type.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
type.use: All UI and all running text: body, comments, controls (set explicitly on button, input, select and textarea), the header nav, and every admin heading. Installed fonts only, since CSP default-src 'self' refuses webfonts.

type.name: --font-serif
type.value: Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', 'Sitka Heading', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, serif
type.use: The editorial voice, for display only: the brand wordmark, reader page titles (main.reader h1), reader section heads (main.reader h2) and the titles in the All reports list. All installed system faces: Charter on Apple, Sitka or Georgia on Windows, Georgia or the default serif elsewhere. Never used for body text or in the admin main.

type.name: --font-mono
type.value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
type.use: Inline code, the slug cells of the admin table, and the SHA-256 dd.

type.name: --text-xs
type.use: Badges, status pills, table header cells (uppercase), and the eyebrow h3 in blocked-account cards.

type.name: --text-sm
type.use: Buttons, nav, sidebar items, bylines, meta lines, hints, labels, disclosures, notices, table body, dt, and the file input.

type.name: --text-md
type.use: Body text, comment bodies, inputs, selects and textareas (16px, so phones do not zoom on focus), admin title links in the table, and empty states. html, body, main, section, article, .comment, .comments, .body and .replies never set a font-size.

type.name: --text-lg
type.use: The admin lede, the vote stats (.likes, .comment-count), .tally, and blocked-account headings.

type.name: --text-xl
type.use: The brand wordmark and admin h2 section heads.

type.name: --text-2xl
type.use: Reader section heads (Feedback for the author, Comments, Thread) and the titles in the All reports list, in serif.

type.name: --text-3xl
type.use: Admin page titles in the page head, and the Not allowed h1, in sans.

type.name: --text-display
type.use: Reader page titles (the report title, All reports, hband on the empty home), in serif.

type.name: weights
type.use: 400 for text and inputs. 500 for header nav links and sidebar items. 600 for buttons, labels, disclosures, logins, stats, th, dt, badges, pills, admin h2 and the current sidebar item. 700 for every h1, reader h2, list titles and the brand.

type.name: --leading
type.use: Body, comment bodies, feedback bodies and textareas.

type.name: --leading-tight
type.use: Buttons, inputs, bylines, nav, the table, and admin headings.

type.name: --leading-display
type.use: Reader h1 and the serif section heads (1.2 for list titles).

type.name: tracking
type.value: display -0.02em; --text-3xl and --text-2xl -0.01em; table header .05em uppercase; eyebrow h3 .06em uppercase; badge and pill .02em
type.use: Tightens large type and opens small caps.

type.name: numerals
type.use: Stats, .tally, the admin table, dd values and the All reports numbers line.

type.name: headings
type.value: text-wrap: balance on h1, h2 and h3
type.use: Long report titles break into even lines.

space.name: --space-1
space.use: Byline to body (the pinned .body margin), the tray's top margin, gap between sidebar items.

space.name: --space-2
space.use: Label to its field, gap between buttons, byline column gap, chevron to text, header row gap.

space.name: --space-3
space.use: Textarea to its button, notice and tray padding, h1 to the meta line, sidebar item side padding, admin table cell padding.

space.name: --space-4
space.use: Button side padding, gap between form rows and between cards, h2 to its content, own-feedback separators.

space.name: --space-5
space.use: Gap between stats, padding under the page head, the header nav column gap, the dl column gap, the All reports row padding.

space.name: --space-6
space.use: Page head to content on admin pages, and the comment form to the first comment.

space.name: --space-7
space.use: Report frame to the votes bar, and the vertical padding of page-level empty states.

space.name: --space-8
space.use: The forbidden page's top padding, and main's bottom padding.

space.name: --space-section
space.use: Between reader sections (votes bar to Feedback, Feedback to Comments). Used only in margin-top longhands.

space.name: --space-head
space.use: From the reader meta line to the report frame, and from the All reports legend to the list.

space.name: --panel-pad
space.use: Padding inside admin cards and the upload form.

space.name: --control-h
space.use: Minimum height of every button, input, select and file-selector button.

space.name: --disclosure-h
space.use: Minimum height of summaries, the replies toggle and the continue link: above the WCAG 2.2 AA 24px target, and calmer in a deep thread.

space.name: gutter
space.use: The page's side gutter at every width: 32px in total, which the 360px thread model reads. main's shorthand always stays literal. Other vertical values are padding-top or padding-bottom longhands.

space.name: page widths
space.value: main.reader 72rem (70rem of content); .admin 72rem (13rem sidebar plus main); plain main 40rem
space.use: Centred columns. The header's inset puts its content on the same 70rem edges.

space.name: reading measure
space.use: Centred with margin-left and margin-right auto: the votes bar, the feedback section, the comments section, the branch thread, the All reports list, and the reader empty states.

space.name: headline measure
space.use: Centred reader h1, meta line and legend.

space.name: admin measure
space.use: Admin cards, the dl, the inbox, moderation, blocked accounts, the lede and the upload form, left-aligned in the admin main. The table and the preview frame take the full width.

space.name: header inset
space.use: Puts the header's content on the edges of the 70rem reader column and of the .admin container's content.

space.name: thread geometry (unchanged)
space.value: .replies margin-left .75rem + padding-left .5rem + a 1px line = 21px a level; .comment margin 1.25rem 0
space.use: A level-5 body keeps 259px at 375 and 244px at 360.

shape.name: --radius-sm
shape.use: Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, the file-selector button, sidebar items, inline code, the confirm tray, inline empty states, and the right corners of notices and author replies.

shape.name: --radius
shape.use: Admin cards, the dl, the upload form, both report frames and page-level empty states.

shape.name: hairline
shape.value: 1px solid var(--divider), written as a literal width and style with a border-*-color longhand
shape.use: The header's bottom edge, the votes bar's top and bottom, the All reports list rules, table rules, card edges, the page-head rule, own-feedback separators and the report frame edge.

shape.name: control edge
shape.use: Neutral buttons, inputs, selects, textareas and the file-selector button. Primary and danger buttons take a 1px edge in their own fill colour.

shape.name: notice edge
shape.value: 4px solid on the left only, in the notice's role colour

shape.name: reply edge
shape.value: 2px solid var(--accent) on the left only
shape.use: The author's reply (.feedback-reply), drawn like a pull-quote rule in ink.

shape.name: thread line
shape.value: 1px solid var(--thread) on the left only

shape.name: tray edge
shape.use: The open confirm tray of the two-step Remove and Block.

shape.name: focus ring
shape.use: Every :focus-visible element. Text inputs, selects and textareas also turn their border --focus. It is never removed.

shape.name: avatar ring
shape.use: Avatars, so a dark or missing image still reads as a circle. This is the only box-shadow in the system.

shape.name: shadows
shape.use: Elevation comes from hairlines and --surface. There is no translucent colour anywhere, and nothing on the report frames but border, radius and Canvas.

shape.name: pressed
shape.use: Every button and the file-selector button while :active. There are no transitions and no animations.

components.name: Site header
states: signed out: All reports, then the ink 'Sign in with GitHub' button
signed-in reader: All reports, avatar, muted 'Signed in as @login', quiet Sign out
owner: as signed in, with the Admin link before Sign out
no avatar URL: the who text alone
nav link hover: a 1px underline at offset .25em
keyboard focus: the 2px --focus ring at offset 2px on the brand, each link and Sign out
39-character login: the who text breaks anywhere inside the nav, and the page never widens
brand only (Not allowed page): the bar holds the Brand alone
phone: the nav wraps onto a second row under the brand, left-aligned

components.name: Brand
components.look: 'hband' as a wordmark: --font-serif, --text-xl, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.01em, --text, no underline, line-height 1. It has no mark or icon.
states: hover: a 2px underline at offset .2em, colour unchanged
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Admin sidebar
states: current page (aria-current=page): --surface-2 fill and weight 600. Reports on /admin and /admin/reports/<slug>; Blocked users on /admin/blocked
hover: --surface-2 fill
pressed: colour --accent-hover
keyboard focus: the focus ring around the item
desktop (1280): a 13rem column left of the page, its items aligned with the header brand
phone (375): one row of three items above the page head, sharing the width; below 20rem of nav width (a 320px phone) they stack

components.name: Page head (admin)
components.look:
div.page-head at the top of each admin main:
- display flex, flex-wrap wrap, align-items center, justify-content space-between;
- gap --space-3 vertical and --space-5 horizontal;
- margin 0 0 --space-6, padding-bottom --space-5, and a 1px --divider bottom edge.

Children:
- An optional .crumb: a Back link, --text-sm, flex-basis 100%, margin 0.
- The h1: --font-sans, --text-3xl, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.01em, line-height --leading-tight, margin 0, flex 1 1 18rem, min-width 0.
- The page's main action (an a.primary, or a form holding a button) at the right: flex none, margin 0.
states: /admin: the 'Reports' title and the ink 'Upload a report' action at the top right
/admin/reports/<slug> (draft): the crumb '‹ Reports', the title, and the ink 'Publish' action at the top right
/admin/reports/<slug> (published): the same, with a neutral 'Unpublish' action
/admin/blocked: the title alone, with no action
long title: balances over two lines while the action stays on the right
phone: the title fills the first line and the action wraps under it, left-aligned

components.name: Link
components.look:
Colour --link, with a 1px underline at offset .2em. Visited links keep the same colour and are never purple. It is written as :where(a), so every variant overrides it at no specificity cost.

Variants:
- **Nav and sidebar link:** --text, no underline.
- **Title link** (All reports h2, the admin table's first column): --text, no underline.
- **Meta link** (.meta a): --text-muted with the underline.
- **Back link** (.back): inline-flex, with a left-pointing ::before chevron (the Disclosure chevron rotated 135deg).
- **Continue link** (.continue): --text-sm, weight 600, inline-flex, min-height --disclosure-h.
states: hover: the underline thickens to 2px; title links and nav links gain a 1px underline; meta links turn --text
pressed (:active): colour --accent-hover
visited: unchanged
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Primary button
states: hover: --accent-hover fill and edge
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the --focus ring at offset 2px, with a page-coloured gap between the ring and the fill
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge, cursor not-allowed, no hover

components.name: Neutral button
components.look:
The secondary action. It is written as :where(button), with every state inside :where(), so class-bound buttons always win:
- --surface fill, 1px --border edge, --text;
- --text-sm, weight 600, min-height --control-h, padding 0 --space-4, --radius-sm.

It never sets display. Used for: Thumbs up, Thumbs down, Take back my vote, Unpublish, Unblock, and Sign out on the Not allowed page.
states: hover: --surface-2 fill
pressed: edge --text-muted, translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the focus ring
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge, cursor not-allowed

components.name: Quiet button
components.look:
A ghost button for chrome:
- no fill, no border, --text;
- --text-sm, weight 600, padding 0 --space-3, min-height --control-h, --radius-sm.

Bound to .quiet and .site-header button (the header's Sign out).
states: hover: --surface-2 fill
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Danger button
states: hover: --danger-hover fill and edge
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the blue --focus ring
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge

components.name: Disclosure
states: closed or folded: muted text with the chevron pointing right ('Reply', 'Show replies')
open or expanded: the chevron points down; an open Reply summary turns --text ('Hide replies')
hover: --text, underlined at offset .2em, no fill
keyboard focus: the focus ring around the text
toggle before thread.js runs: not drawn (hidden guard)

components.name: Two-step destructive control
components.look:
<details class='remove|block'>, with the markup unchanged.

Step 1 is the summary, drawn as a Disclosure in --danger with a --danger chevron ('Remove', 'Block').

Step 2 is the open form, a confirm tray:
- --danger-soft fill, 1px --danger edge, --radius-sm;
- padding --space-3, margin --space-1 0 --space-3;
- width fit-content, max-width 100%.

The tray holds the Danger button ('Remove for everyone', 'Block @login'). No display is set on the details element.
states: closed: the danger summary only
summary hover: danger text with an underline
open: the tray appears under the summary with the filled confirm
confirm hover: --danger-hover
keyboard focus: the ring on the summary, then on the confirm
at the depth cap (244px at 360): the tray and its button fit, and 'Block @<39 chars>' wraps inside the button

components.name: Text input
states: hover: edge --text-muted
keyboard focus: edge --focus plus the focus ring
error (:user-invalid after the person has edited it): edge --danger
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge
empty: blank; the label above says what goes in

components.name: Textarea
components.look:
The same box as the Text input, with line-height --leading, min-height 6rem and resize vertical.

In the comment, reply, feedback and inbox forms it is display block, width 100%, max-width 100% and margin 0 0 --space-3. That comes through the pinned '.comments textarea, .feedback textarea, .feedback-inbox textarea {' rule, which never says font: inherit.
states: hover: edge --text-muted
keyboard focus: edge --focus plus the focus ring
error (:user-invalid): edge --danger
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted

components.name: Select
components.look: The same box as the Text input. appearance is left alone, so Chrome draws its own arrow in the current scheme. Width 100% inside a Form row.
states: hover: edge --text-muted
keyboard focus: edge --focus plus the ring
open: the browser's own list, in the scheme set by color-scheme
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted

components.name: File picker
states: hover: the selector button takes --surface-2
keyboard focus: the focus ring around the whole input
file chosen: its name in --text-muted beside the button
phone: the name wraps under the button, and the input never exceeds the row

components.name: Checkbox and radio
components.look:
Not in today's markup; designed for later. A native control, 1.125rem square, margin 0, with accent-color --accent (ink).

Its label (label:has(> input[type=checkbox], > input[type=radio])) is inline-flex, align-items center, gap --space-2, weight 400.
states: checked: an ink fill drawn by the browser
keyboard focus: the focus ring
disabled: the browser's dimmed control and a --text-muted label

components.name: Form row and errors
states: field error: the field's danger edge (:user-invalid)
refused upload: the danger notice under the page head, with the form below refilled
keyboard focus: the field's ring; the label is unchanged

components.name: Card
states: static: no hover and no focus of its own; its links and controls carry those

components.name: Votes bar
states: signed out: '3 likes   2 comments   Sign in to vote.' on one line
signed in, not voted: the stats, then Thumbs up and Thumbs down
voted: the stats, 'Your vote: thumbs up.', then three buttons including Take back my vote
singular wording ('1 like') comes from the markup unchanged
phone: the stats and hint wrap, and the buttons wrap onto a second row if needed

components.name: Notice
states: 'Sent to the author.': not drawn until the URL fragment is #feedback-sent, then the success notice under the feedback form
refused action (p.error role=alert): the danger notice under the admin page head
long message: wraps, and the edge runs its full height

components.name: Hint
components.look:
Secondary text: --text-sm, --text-muted.

Bound to: .hint, .meta, .legend, .vote-hint, .comment-hint, .feedback-hint, .feedback-note, .your-vote and .reply-to. Every time element is --text-muted. A link inside a hint stays --link, except inside .meta, where it is the meta link.
states: static; a link inside follows the Link states

components.name: Lede
components.look: The intro paragraph of an admin page (.lede): --text-lg, --text-muted, line-height --leading, max-width 44rem, margin 0 0 --space-6.
states: static

components.name: Badge
components.look:
An inline-flex pill: padding .0625rem .5rem, --radius-pill, --text-xs, weight 600, letter-spacing .02em, line-height 1.4, no border.
- Default ('Author'): an ink pill, --accent fill with --on-accent text, the editorial mark of the author.
- Danger ('blocked', .feedback-inbox .feedback-message > .byline .badge): --danger text on --danger-soft.
states: static

components.name: Status pill
components.look:
span.pill.pill-<status> in the admin table and the dl:
- inline-flex, align-items center, gap .375rem;
- padding .125rem .5rem .125rem .4375rem, --radius-pill;
- --text-xs, weight 600, letter-spacing .02em, text-transform capitalize, white-space nowrap.

A ::before dot: content '', .375rem circle, currentColor fill (background-color: currentColor).
- .pill-published: --ok text on --ok-soft.
- .pill-draft: --text-muted text on --surface-2.
The word comes from the data unchanged.
states: published: an ok-tinted 'Published' pill with an ok dot
draft: a grey 'Draft' pill with a muted dot
phone: the pill never breaks, and its cell wraps around it

components.name: Avatar
components.look: A 24px circle (from its width and height attributes), border-radius 50%, a --surface-2 placeholder fill, the avatar ring, object-fit cover, vertical-align middle, flex none. It is 2rem in a blocked-account heading.
states: image loaded: the photo inside the ring
image missing or refused (alt=''): a plain --surface-2 circle with its ring, never a broken-image glyph

components.name: Byline
components.look:
.byline: flex, wrapping, align-items center, gap --space-1 vertical and --space-2 horizontal, --text-sm, line-height --leading-tight, --text-muted.

Items: the Avatar, then .login (weight 600, --text, overflow-wrap anywhere), then a Badge, then the time (--text-muted). 'You wrote <time>' uses the same byline.
states: long login: breaks anywhere, and the badge and time wrap to the next line
removed comment: no byline; the placeholder instead

components.name: Comment thread
components.look:
Unboxed on the page, inside the 40rem column. No comment wrapper ever gains horizontal padding, border or width.
- .comment: margin 1.25rem 0.
- Byline, then .body: --text-md, --text, line-height --leading, margin .25rem 0, pre-wrap, wrapping anywhere, overflow clip.
- The Reply Disclosure; open, its form holds a Textarea and the Primary 'Post reply', with form margin --space-1 0 --space-3.
- For the owner, the Two-step destructive control.
- The toggle Disclosure.
- .replies: indented .75rem, with .5rem padding and a 1px --thread line.
- The placeholder (.removed): --text-sm, --text-muted, italic.
- At the cap, .cut holds the Continue link 'continue this thread →'.

Above the thread, the comment form (signed in) is unboxed: a label with its Textarea, then the Primary 'Post comment', with margin 0 0 --space-6.
states: signed out: the muted 'Sign in to comment.' hint, then the thread
before thread.js: no toggles drawn, every thread open
folded: 'Show replies' with a right chevron; the replies hidden ([hidden])
expanded: 'Hide replies' with a down chevron
reply open: the textarea and Post reply under the summary
owner: Remove under Reply; open, the danger tray
removed comment with visible replies: the italic 'comment removed', then its replies
depth cap: 'continue this thread →' at 32px tap height
unbroken 300-character body or 39-character login: wraps inside the 244px body at 360
no comments: the inline Empty state 'No comments yet.'

components.name: Feedback message
states: no own messages: the list is absent
message with no reply: the body only
one or more author replies: stacked, ink-edged blocks
blocked sender (inbox): the danger 'blocked' badge in the byline
no feedback (inbox): the inline Empty state

components.name: Report frame
components.look:
iframe: display block, max-width 100%, a 1px --divider edge, --radius, background-color Canvas. Nothing else, ever: no color-scheme, filter, opacity, blend or shadow on the frame or on any ancestor below :root.

The reader frame (.report-frame) is width 100% of the 70rem column, height 80vh, min-height 24rem, like a full-bleed feature image under the title. The admin preview has the same look at its height attribute (600).

foundation:
**The stylesheet.** Every visual decision lives in one file, internal/server/static/site.css, served same-origin at /static/site.css (staticFS) under the unchanged siteCSP (style-src 'self'). Its order:
1. Line 1: `:root { color-scheme: light dark; }`.
2. A second :root holding every token: colours as light-dark(#hex6, #hex6), the font families, the type scale, space and shape.
3. The `[hidden]:not(:target) { display: none !important; }` guard.
4. The element baseline.
5. The components, bound to today's classes, elements and form actions, plus the new admin classes (.admin, .admin-nav, .page-head, .crumb, .pill, .pill-published, .pill-draft, .lede, .empty, .empty-inline, .upload).
6. The page parts, including every pinned rule text.

The file has no at-rule, so dark mode comes only from light-dark() under color-scheme, which follows the visitor's prefers-color-scheme.

**The shell.** The single <link> to the stylesheet sits in the "head" partial of internal/layout/templates/base.html, which internal/layout/layout.go embeds (layout.FS). "page-start" (doctype, html, head, the ThreadScript-gated thread.js tag, body, and the consuming set's "header") and "page-end" open and close every page:
- internal/server parses layout.FS and then its own templates through parsePages() in internal/server/router.go. Its "header" define in internal/server/templates/layout.html stays byte-unchanged.
- The same file gains one new define, "admin-nav": the sidebar, called with the current section as its dot.
- internal/auth/owner.go parses layout.FS and then internal/auth/templates/forbidden.html, which defines a brand-only "header".

**The pages.** Every page template takes the look through page-start and page-end, with no own head, no style block and no style attribute:
- report.html, branch.html and all_reports.html are byte-unchanged, so they keep the reader byte-identity proof.
- admin.html, admin_report.html and admin_blocked.html wrap their main in `<div class="admin">` after `{{template "admin-nav" "<section>"}}`.
- forbidden.html.
- comments.html and feedback.html are partials inside report.html and branch.html.

A later page gets the look by opening with page-start and closing with page-end. A later admin page also takes the .admin wrapper and admin-nav. A later colour is a new light-dark() token in :root plus a row in TestStylesheetTokens.
